name: @intellectual-frontiers/archon-dialect-winget
description: The dialect of tools for Archon that installs them with WinGet: WinGet, whose manifests carry the SHA-256 of each installer, which it checks before it runs one.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
